prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Draw a giraffe version of 大笑奶龙, a chubby yellow cartoon creature caught mid-guffaw. Give it a pear-shaped golden body, a soft double chin, tiny forelegs and a long, plump neck that bunches into folds as it throws its head back. Make it unmistakably a giraffe with two short knob-tipped horns, leaf-shaped ears and a few large caramel patches down the neck. Let the laugh take over its whole face: eyes squeezed into little crescents, cheeks pushed up, broad rounded muzzle tilted skyward and a huge open mouth with a pink tongue resting inside. Its belly juts forward and its little hooves curl toward its chest as if it can barely stand up from laughing. Use a close three-quarter view, cropped at the belly, with the entire head and both horns in frame. Render it like a still from a playful 3D cartoon, with smooth, softly lit shapes and a plain pale background. No lettering or watermark.
